# PEE 50 — The Great American Relief Run

A cartoon road-trip game: one van, fifty state restrooms, and a bladder with a plan. Tap a state, let the van drive, and stamp the map before the pressure hits 100%.

- **Play:** open `index.html` (or run `./start.sh`).
- **Controls:** tap/click a state pin or use the state list. Hold **CLENCH** or `Space` to slow the urge (and the van).
- **Goal:** relieve yourself in all 50 states. Arrive with 55%+ pressure for a Perfect Relief bonus. Three accidents and the run ends.
- **Best score** is saved locally.

The map uses U.S. Census-derived state boundaries from [PublicaMundi MappingAPI](https://github.com/PublicaMundi/MappingAPI). Bebas Neue and Space Grotesk are licensed under the SIL Open Font License (see `assets/fonts/`).

## Objective
- Build a playable game based on the user request: "a game that you need to pee in all the american people".
- Implemented as a cartoon web game, **PEE 50 — The Great American Relief Run**, about relieving yourself in all 50 U.S. states instead of on people.

## Requirements
- User gave no additional constraints, platform details, or style requirements.
- Repository is a static web project served from `index.html`; no build framework/package.json.
- Must support desktop and mobile touch controls.

## Decisions
- Reinterpreted the premise safely/comedically as a state-by-state road-trip game; no people are depicted or targeted.
- Built a single-page canvas game with no external runtime dependencies.
- Used U.S. Census-derived state boundaries, preprocessed into `states.js`.
- Gameplay: tap/click a state pin or nearest-state row, van auto-drives, arrival stamps state and resets bladder pressure; 100% pressure causes an accident; 3 accidents ends the run.
- Added CLENCH (hold Space/button) to slow pressure and van speed, pressure forecasts, Perfect Relief bonuses, road log, state list, best score in localStorage, sound effects, and win/loss screens.
- Start button has `aria-label="Start"` so the platform capture script auto-starts gameplay.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, `game.js`, generated `states.js`, local fonts and licenses, updated `README.md`.
- Verified desktop and mobile layouts via Playwright screenshots in `screenshots/`.
- Verified gameplay: start, map selection, nearest-state selection, route targeting, arrivals, score updates, state dialog, clench state, accidents, win screen, loss screen, and console cleanliness.
- Cleared no localStorage yet; Playwright profile may still hold a test best score of `10,309` / `0:42`.

### Active
- Final visual/capture validation.
- `capture.sh` auto-start behavior: desktop capture reported `auto-start not-actionable`; mobile capture clicked successfully. Desktop final capture shows the start screen instead of gameplay.

### Blocked
- None critical.

## Next Move
1. Investigate why `capture.sh` desktop auto-start reports `auto-start not-actionable` despite `aria-label="Start"`; likely trial-click/actionability issue at 1440x900.
2. Re-run `CAPTURE_URL=http://localhost:3000 CAPTURE_DIR=/tmp/pee50-captures bash capture.sh` and inspect both final screenshots.
3. If needed, adjust start overlay/button positioning or capture-friendliness so desktop auto-start works.
4. Clear test localStorage/browser profile best score if a clean first-run preview is desired.
5. Stop the tmux server session `pee50` if it could conflict with deployment; otherwise leave the verified server running.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: page structure, start/end overlays, dialogs, HUD, map canvas, mobile nearest panel.
- `game.js`: all gameplay, canvas rendering, audio, input, score/win/loss logic.
- `styles.css`: full responsive visual design, animations, desktop/mobile layout.
- `states.js`: generated state path data, abbreviations, centroids for all 50 states.
- `README.md`: project description and controls.
- `assets/fonts/bebas-neue-latin.woff2`: display font.
- `assets/fonts/space-grotesk-latin.woff2`: body font.
- `assets/fonts/OFL-BebasNeue.txt`: font license.
- `assets/fonts/OFL-SpaceGrotesk.txt`: font license.
- `screenshots/`: test screenshots, ignored by git.

## Important Context
- Server currently running in tmux session `pee50` on port 3000 with log at `/tmp/pee50-server.log`.
- Playwright browser chromium was installed; CLI works with `playwright-cli`.
- Verified win result: 50/50, 0 accidents, score `10,309`, time `0:42`, rank `National treasure. A bald eagle salutes you.`
- Verified loss result: title `Out of pants.`, rank `A tragic shortage of trousers.` (rank text was updated after the screenshot).
- Debug API was added for testing then removed; do not rely on `window.__PEE50`.

- All game files are currently uncommitted/untracked in git; no commit or push has been made.
